name: North Dakota
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. North Dakota's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): Montana in the west, South Dakota in the south, the Canadian border in the north, the Red River in the east. Landlocked, so there is no water to trim. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-nd.
